decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The rooflights of the proposed development shall be of purpose-made obscure glass and thereafter be retained in that form.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The refuse/recycling bins associated with the development shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area inside the proposed building, as shown on the approved drawing.

The premises shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification).

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

Prior to the commencement of development above damp proof course level, full details of any external lighting to be installed on the site have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the position, height, design, and luminance of all lighting columns and fixtures, the spread and intensity of illumination (including horizontal and vertical light spill diagrams), and measures to prevent light pollution and glare to neighbouring properties and the wider environment. The external lighting shall be installed and operated only in full accordance with the approved details and retained as such thereafter.

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved (other than demolition works),&nbsp;details for the proposed disposal of any foul and surface water run off, including separate connections and any onsite surface water storage details required, have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.  The works shall thereafter be retained.

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245); color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to the commencement of development above damp proof course level,</span><span style="background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245); color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">&nbsp;</span>&nbsp;a Fire Safety Statement is submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:
</p><ol><li>identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: <br>a) for fire appliances to be positioned on <br>b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point</li><li> is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures 
</li><li>is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread </li><li>provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users </li><li>develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in
</li><li>provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.
</li></ol><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be those as expressly stated in the applicant's Design and Access Statement, unless otherwise approved or agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The development hereby approved shall be operated with no more than four (4) employees on site at any one time, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Drawing numbers 0001 REV P1; 1100 REV P1; 1110 REV P1; 1200 REV P1; 1210 REV P1; 2000 REV P1; 2010 REV P1; 2020 REV P1; 2030 REV P1; 3000 REV P1; 3010 REV P1; 3020 REV P1; Design and Access Statement.

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245); color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved (other than demolition works),&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>a scheme of hard and soft landscape works shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority, including the following:&nbsp;</p><ol><li>Proposed planting plans at a scale of not less than 1:100.</li><li>Schedule of proposed plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes, proposed numbers and densities, all at the time of proposed planting.&nbsp;</li><li>&nbsp;A landscape implementation programme.&nbsp;</li><li>A landscape maintenance plan covering a period of 5 years from the date of planting.&nbsp;</li><li>A proposed hard landscaping plan, including any boundary treatments proposed.&nbsp;</li></ol><p>The landscaping plans/schemes approved shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development, unless otherwise approved in writing by the local planning authority.</p>
description: Demolition and replacement of existing garages and hardstanding with new purpose-built storage building (Use Class B8); solar panels and associated landscaping
